methods: Positional parser skips three rows; actual CSV order is Date,Adj Close,Close,High,Low,Open,Volume (differs from prompt). Raw Close used, not Adj Close. $7,500 fractional-share notional; $75 per completed trade; close fills, no spreads, slippage, dividends or portfolio constraints. Paper/research only. Frozen original spread model (entry ×1.001, exit ×0.999) reconciles separately. All comparison winner/loser labels use no-spread V0. Losers saved = V0 net ≤0 improved by variant; also report turned positive. Winners cut short = earlier exit, irrespective of profitability. V1 initializes on prior 20 closes; V3 ratchet takes effect after current close. Stops checked from entry+1, before time exit at entry+10. Entries stay fixed even if alternative trades overlap; no rescheduling. V1 has two terminal pending trades: all 434 entries attempted, only 432 completed; no forced terminal liquidation or fabricated exit. Comparisons use matched completed entry keys; total P/L is therefore censored for V1.
